Use case: stylized-concept, original game-world background illustration.
Create one original full-bleed horizontal pixel-art vignette, roughly 2.2:1 aspect ratio, for a tiny 178 by 82 pixel upgrade-card background in a dark underground cyberpunk server vault. This is environmental artwork, with no interface elements. Crisp deliberate chunky pixel clusters and stepped square edges, a finely crafted 1990s pixel-art / HD-2D game background, never photorealistic or smoothly rendered 3D. The hardware needs a strong instantly recognizable silhouette even at 178 by 82 pixels.

Subject: a large chunky industrial axial cooling fan, viewed from a slight three-quarter angle, recessed into a worn dark teal metal mounting frame, broad readable fan blades, thick teal coolant pipes and a single subtle cold cyan status light. The fan and its defining pipes occupy the RIGHTMOST 40 percent of the composition, chiefly x60% to x94%, without cutting off its main silhouette. Worn rivets and restrained amber edge glints tie it to an underground server room. The focal fan is cool teal and cyan, with very little light spill.

The LEFT 55 percent must remain very dark, low contrast and visually quiet: a continuous equipment-wall environment of deep charcoal steel, dim teal wall planes, broad recessed panel seams and a barely visible pipe, suitable behind separately composed sharp game text. Do not make a flat UI panel or a black rectangular overlay. The quiet left environment and detailed right machinery belong naturally to the same room. Leave the left completely free of focal objects, bright lights and diagonal beams.

Limited palette: near-black charcoal, deep industrial teal, muted cold cyan, a few dim copper/amber wear highlights. Opaque edge-to-edge illustration. No lettering, numbers, symbols, logos, warning labels, typography, borders, panels that resemble interface cards, icon badges, people or creatures. No global fog, bloom, lens flare, soft gradients, airbrush glow, tiny noisy visual clutter, smooth 3D surfaces or photographic textures. Keep detail grouped into bold readable blocks.
